description: Data dictionary for the credit scoring feature set. 'timing' classifies each feature as sample_point (known at application time — safe to use) or outcome_point (only known after the loan performs — would be leakage). All 21 current features are sample_point. Source is the primary origin; many fall back to loan_application.metadata (JSONB) when the relational column is null (see fastapi/app/features.py).

features.name: married
features.fairness_flag: possible protected/proxy attribute — pending Tanzania fair-lending review

features.name: education
features.fairness_flag: possible proxy attribute — pending fair-lending review

features.name: dependents
features.fairness_flag: possible proxy attribute — pending fair-lending review

features.name: spouse_employment_status
features.description: FINDING: never populated from source; constant default. Effectively a dead feature.

features.name: monthly_income
features.source: MAX(employment gross salary, 6-month income-history avg, metadata.monthlySalary, cms_uaa income)
features.description: Monthly income. FINDING: blind MAX across sources can be inflated by one bad value (Gap 4 / Phase 6).

features.name: residense_status
features.fairness_flag: possible proxy attribute — pending fair-lending review

features.name: vehicle_ownership_status
features.description: Whether the applicant owns a vehicle.

features.name: credit_history_length_months
features.description: FINDING: labelled 'credit history' but actually derived from EMPLOYMENT duration — a mislabel/proxy, not true credit history.

features.name: total_outstanding_debt
features.description: Aggregate outstanding debt across active applications.

features.name: number_of_late_payments_36
features.description: FINDING: never populated from source; constant 0. Effectively a dead feature (no real delinquency history available).

features.name: active_loans
features.source: count of active applications (+1 if party_person.has_other_loan)

features.name: avg_monthly_balance
features.source: MAX(net salary, income-history avg, gross salary)

features.name: previous_collateral_value
features.description: Total value of collateral on qualifying applications.

features.name: debt_to_income_ratio
features.description: Debt-to-income ratio (drives the DTI guard rail).
